title: Veiled Child and Cosmic Cats
description: A young person with curly dark hair and a starry green veil covering their head looks directly at the viewer. A large green serpent coils in the foreground while a purple cat and an orange tabby cat with glowing eyes leap through iridescent bubbles against a swirling psychedelic sky.
prompt: A young person with curly dark hair wearing a translucent green veil decorated with stars, constellations and alchemical symbols, half their face covered in golden esoteric tattoos, standing in a field. A giant glowing green serpent with intricate scales coils in the foreground. A purple cat and an orange striped cat with luminous eyes leap through soap bubbles. Dramatic swirling pink and green clouds fill the sky in a psychedelic vortex pattern, vibrant fantasy surrealism, detailed, colorful, mystical atmosphere.
